# aslan/payment-laravel

> Laravel 12/13 integration for the Aslan Payment API (Morocco, MAD): a configured SDK client and `Aslan` facade, `Aslan::paywall()` for the subscription Paywall (HTML form POST, not a redirect), and a signature-verified webhook route that dispatches typed Laravel events. Amounts are integer centimes. Requires PHP ~8.2.35 || ~8.3.36 || ~8.4.27 || >=8.5.12.

Agents: read AGENTS.md first; it contains the rules, the intent-to-call table, and the anti-patterns.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules and canonical calls for AI coding agents
- [README.md](README.md): full guide (installation, one-time payments, subscriptions, webhooks, testing, configuration, events)
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release notes
